summary: eth-batcher ships an obfuscated require-time executor behind a cover-story library
details: index.js is a verbatim copy of an unrelated Mongoose LeanHooks Plugin with a ~149 KB obfuscated Function(...) payload concatenated onto the module.exports line. On require(), the payload constructs and executes code decoded from a hex byte table via an XOR/rotation decoder. The advertised purpose in package.json (Ethereum JSON-RPC batching) does not match the shipped code, which contains no Ethereum or Web3 logic — the mismatched benign source acts as a cover for the appended dropper. Any process that imports this package executes the decoded payload at load time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
